name: Trace every child-session delete
description: Multi-hop trace: four of the five call sites are direct, but maybeCleanupChildSession is only reachable by following readOutput -> markRetrieved, so it separates models that follow a call chain from models that stop at the first grep.
brief: In this repository, find EVERY code path in the background-agents plugin that deletes an OpenCode child session. Report each one as an absolute path with a line number and one line on when it fires. Then state how many distinct call sites you found.
